bank.title: PART 1: KEY CRITERIA REPORTED

subs.title: How it's reported
items: Dedicated Bowel Section: Placed under Bowel / Gastrointestinal (or as the prominent lead if positive).

subs.title: Key Criteria Reported
items: Outer Diameter: Non-compressible, blind-ending tubular structure measuring greater than 6 mm in outer-to-outer transverse diameter.
Wall Thickness & Compressibility: Thickened, hyperemic wall that fails to compress under transducer pressure.
Surrounding Findings: Echogenic inflammatory periappendiceal fat stranding, loculated pericecal fluid, or an appendicolith (echogenic focus with posterior acoustic shadowing).
Doppler: Hyperemia (increased color/power Doppler flow within the inflamed appendiceal wall).

subs.title: Sample Finding Block
items: Bowel / Gastrointestinal: In the right lower quadrant, a blind-ending, non-compressible tubular structure arising from the cecal base is identified, measuring [X.X] mm in maximal outer diameter with thickened walls and marked wall hyperemia on color Doppler. Surrounding echogenic inflammatory fat stranding is present. A calcified appendicolith measuring [X.X] mm with acoustic shadowing is noted within the appendiceal lumen. No free intraperitoneal air.
Appendicitis is evaluated using graded compression in the right lower quadrant, tracing the terminal ileum down to the cecal pole.

bank.title: PART 2: MODULAR DIAGNOSTIC PHRASE BANK — APPENDICITIS

subs.title: Normal Appendix (Visualized)
items: The normal appendix is visualized in its entirety in the right lower quadrant, measuring [X.X] mm (less than 6 mm) in maximal outer diameter, fully compressible with no mural hyperemia or surrounding inflammatory fat stranding.

subs.title: Non-Visualized Appendix (Clean Negative)
items: The appendix is not definitively visualized due to overlying bowel gas/retrocecal position; however, there are no secondary signs of acute appendicitis (no inflammatory fat stranding, focal fluid collection, cecal wall thickening, or right lower quadrant lymphadenopathy).

subs.title: Equivocal / Borderline Appendix (6–7 mm)
items: A blind-ending tubular structure in the right lower quadrant measures [6.2] mm in maximal outer diameter with borderline compressibility and minimal mural hyperemia, without significant surrounding fat stranding. Findings are equivocal for early/mild acute appendicitis; close clinical and laboratory correlation is recommended.

subs.title: Uncomplicated Acute Appendicitis
items: Blind-ending, non-compressible, tubular structure in the right lower quadrant measuring [X.X] mm in maximal outer diameter with concentric wall thickening, marked mural hyperemia on color Doppler, and surrounding echogenic inflammatory fat stranding, consistent with acute appendicitis.

subs.title: Perforated / Gangrenous Appendicitis
items: Dilated, non-compressible appendix measuring [X.X] mm with focal loss of the echogenic submucosal layer, diminished/absent mural Doppler flow (concerning for gangrenous change), and an adjacent complex, loculated periappendiceal fluid collection measuring [X.X] x [X.X] cm, consistent with perforated appendicitis complicated by periappendiceal abscess.

subs.title: Appendicolith
items: An intraluminal echogenic focus with dense posterior acoustic shadowing measuring [X.X] mm is identified within the [base / mid-body / tip] of the appendix, consistent with an appendicolith.
